verdict.rationale: Docusaurus is a docs-site generator, so automatically serving llms.txt is a fair axis. No evidence shows built-in or official-plugin generation of llms.txt or a full-content variant, and the probe found docusaurus.io's own /llms.txt returns 404. The pluggable architecture is only a developer building block and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my published docs site automatically serves llms.txt (and a full-content variant) so agents can index it
